name: VoxPopuli
description: A large-scale multilingual speech corpus collected from European Parliament recordings, including transcribed speech and unlabeled audio for speech recognition and representation learning.
citation: Wang, C., Rottmann, K., Dauwels, J., et al. (2021). VoxPopuli: A Large-Scale Multilingual Speech Corpus for Representation Learning, Semi-Supervised Learning and Interpretation. Proceedings of the 59th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics and the 11th International Joint Conference on Natural Language Processing, 993–1003. https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2021.acl-long.80
